name: Godot AI
summary: Godot editor add-on plus a Python MCP server that connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other clients to a live Godot editor through 46 tools.
description: Tools build scenes, edit nodes and scripts, wire signals, and configure UI, materials, animation, particles, cameras and environments (README: 46 tools, 120+ operations). Needs Godot 4.7+ and uv. Install the add-on from AssetLib or a GitHub release, enable it, and press Configure in the dock. Latest release v4.3.1 (2026-10-24). Python >=3.11,<3.15.
